name: Algebra 1 Recurring + Assessment Resource Profile
role: Course-specific Warm-Up / Quick Check / Review / Summative behavior. Shared PMs own procedure/rendering; this profile owns current Algebra recurring-resource behavior.

warmups.numbering_rule: Number Warm-Ups 1-20 within the Unit; do not number or group them by section as curriculum authority.
warmups.architecture: Q1 Solve / Equation Fluency; Q2 Diamond / Factoring Pattern; Q3 Planned I Can Retrieval; Q4 Planned I Can Retrieval.
warmups.retrieval_rule: Q3/Q4 use exact Bank I Can code + statement. Unit 3+ favors previous Unit in Q3 and two-units-back/long-range retrieval in Q4. Warm-Up retrieval is additional to section recurrence and is not counted as a mastery_recurrence_map section appearance.
warmups.question_structure_exception: Warm-Ups do not require the universal Question Structure when the stable fluency/retrieval job is already clear.
warmups.calculator_language: For fraction/integer fluency, encourage trying without a calculator first while clearly allowing calculator use if needed.
warmups.offline_generation: Prefer deterministic Bank family generation for Q3/Q4 and deterministic progression scripts for Q1/Q2 when the declared rules are sufficient.

quick_checks.selection_rule: Teacher approves the four exact source question architectures for each section. Portfolio may guide reassessment recommendations; teacher selection is final.
quick_checks.version_rule: All four versions use the same four source architectures. Normal differences are safe number/value/data swaps, deterministic question-order scramble, and answer-choice scramble when applicable.
quick_checks.source_vs_rendered_rule: A Unit has 20 source questions/architectures. Four A-D versions render 80 question instances, but the versions are not 80 separate architecture decisions.
quick_checks.student_label_rule: Every problem visibly prints exact I Can code + full exact I Can statement.

review.target_rule: Unit Review prepares current Unit Mastery Goals/supporting I Cans and does not mean the Section Spiral Review stage.
review.bank_rule: Use approved nonsecure Bank families and current Practice target plans when useful.

summative.evidence_rule: Target approximately two secure evidence opportunities per current Unit Mastery Goal.
summative.time_rule: Design each complete form for about a 40-minute class period.
summative.parallel_rule: Prefer deterministic/seeded comparable siblings when secure family contracts support them safely; otherwise use reviewed secure authored parallels.

targeted_reteach_check.canonical_status: Not automatically a Quick Check, Bank requirement, or Portfolio event.

retired_current_algebra_mechanics: 3 Warm-Ups per section / 15 Warm-Ups per Unit
Warm-Up Q3 generic Skill Review lane
Warm-Up Q4 generic Challenge lane as the fixed course job
